title: Cad Transform Tool Gumball
description: Add transform toolbar category with move, rotate, scale toggles (mutually exclusive). Show gumball for all selected objects when active; apply transforms to primitives on use.
summary: Added transform toolbar category (move, rotate, scale) with mutually exclusive toggles in CAD play. When a tool is active and primitives are selected, SpatialTransformGumball shows at selection centroid and commits vertex transforms via transformGumballMatrixDiff. Extended AppToolCategory with transform; implemented transform.rotate/scale action capabilities. Tests: core 342 pass, renderer gumball + play toolbar tests pass.
